title: PDF viewer no longer re-downloads on workspace switch
description:
Opening a pipe-chart PDF now loads through the portal as a stable in-viewer blob, so the browser will not keep prompting to download when you switch workspace layouts. The iframe also skips reloading the same document on remount, and Exit still returns to the video.

Who is affected: PipeShare users reviewing report PDFs on the private server, and on SaaS after Push.
changeLog: PDF preview uses authenticated portal download + blob URL (no Wasabi attachment iframe).
Workspace tab switches no longer re-trigger PDF preview reloads while a PDF overlay is open.
PDF iframe skips re-setting src when the same document is already loaded.
